children: Intelibly®, an innovative dental-technology platform dedicated to seamlessly connecting patients, providers, and payors, today announced a strategic partnership with Synchrony (NYSE: SYF), a leading consumer financing company. Through this partnership, Synchrony’s CareCredit® health and wellness credit card will be integrated into Intelibly’s platform, giving patients seamless access to financing options at the time they inquire and book appointments, while helping dental practices accelerate revenue cycles and improve treatment acceptance.

Although more than 80% of dentists in the U.S. accept Synchrony’s CareCredit card, many patients are not made actively aware of the ability to finance oral care. Without awareness of financing options, patients may postpone or scale back treatment, while practices face delayed payment cycles.

With Intelibly’s integration, patients receive an invitation to apply for CareCredit as soon as they request or schedule an appointment, ensuring they are aware of financing options before their visit. For providers, this means increased case acceptance and faster payment.

"Our partnership with Synchrony’s CareCredit brings us another step forward in reducing friction in the dental ecosystem because it removes additional barriers for both patients and providers," said Eric Rindler, DDS, CEO of Intelibly. "Patients gain confidence knowing upfront that financing is available for the full scope of care they need, while practices benefit from faster, more reliable payments and an improved patient experience."
Patients can use CareCredit to cover the portion of treatment not covered by insurance and move forward with the care they need, from a single procedure to a comprehensive treatment plan.
“Synchrony is committed to making it easier for patients to say ‘yes’ to the care they need,” said

at Synchrony. “By integrating the CareCredit health and wellness credit card directly into Intelibly’s platform at the moment a patient is inquiring or booking an appointment, we’re helping bring financing into the conversation earlier—supporting higher treatment acceptance for providers, improving the patient experience, and helping practices accelerate their revenue cycle.”
Intelibly continues to grow its network of integrations and partnerships, creating value for both patients and providers—streamlining access to care while strengthening practice performance.

Intelibly removes the friction from the new-patient journey by seamlessly connecting patients to providers and payors for the benefit of all stakeholders. Intelibly’s goal is to streamline patient access to care, enable providers to connect with new patients, and optimize network and practice performance. For more information, visit
